decisions.statement: The folders above a path are answered from the nearest folder outward.
A folder is read off the disk one folder at a time.
No answer here walks below the folder that answer is about.
The files in a folder are what git carries there joined to the paths a change adds.
A path a change takes away is dropped from the folder that path sat in.
A folder a change opens is answered under the folder above that folder.
An uncommitted file opens no folder, so a folder holding only those is no folder here.
Such a file is still among the files of a folder git already carries.
A folder a change leaves holding no file and no folder is no folder here.
A folder is holding nothing where every folder under it is holding nothing too.
An answer is held for the folder that answer was asked about.
A file a generator writes sits in no folder here.
What a generator writes is answered by the caller rather than worked out here.
Each folder a declared file name sits under is a segment of that name.
A folder is such a segment only where the file that name gives sits under that folder.
A folder holding a subfolder is no such segment.
A folder holding a file no declared name gives is no such segment.

definition: the folders a path sits under, and what a change leaves sitting in a folder
